vulnerabilities.title: Potential Command Injection in GitHub Helper Script
vulnerabilities.description: The script joins command arguments with spaces and passes them directly to execSync() without proper escaping. While intended as a helper script, malicious arguments could execute arbitrary commands.
vulnerabilities.exploitability: Requires local access or malicious input to the script
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use shell escaping library or spawn with array arguments instead of string concatenation

vulnerabilities.title: Command Execution in Development Script
vulnerabilities.description: Uses template strings in exec() calls. Low risk as BASE_URL comes from environment variables and script is for development/CI only.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Consider using spawn with argument arrays for better security

safe_patterns_found.reason: Only uses controlled boolean values, no user input reaches this code

react_to_shell_analysis.details: No execution paths from React components to shell commands. All API routes use proper input validation.
